cases.task: Separate identity name/namespace from token contents and Role rules.
cases.expected: A nonsecret identity record is distinct from credential bytes and permissions.

cases.task: Explain the subject namespace versus the RoleBinding namespace.
cases.expected: Subject identifies the ServiceAccount;binding scope determines the namespaced grant.
Only the intended own-namespace Pod reads are allowed;Secrets and privilege changes denied.

cases.task: Inspect automountServiceAccountToken:false in the application source.
cases.expected: The synthetic workload does not receive an automatic API token mount.

cases.task: Explain the sequence when a prepared fifteen-minute lease expires before Run.
cases.expected: Guard refuses;exact owned session is released and a fresh session is prepared immediately before use.

cases.task: With the named host capability,retain positive/negative self-authorization outcomes without credentials.
cases.expected: Identity,target,verb/resource,result and time are recorded;token/kubeconfig contents are excluded.
